prompt.generated_prompt_string: A stylish clearly adult woman poses confidently indoors with dramatic red lighting filling the room. She wears a coordinated red sweater with a large bow detail, a red pleated skirt, and matching red knee-high socks. Her stance is strong and self-assured, with one hand placed on her hip while she looks directly at the camera. Red ambient LED glow fills the background and enhances the bold, eye-catching aesthetic. Use approximately 630nm red LED panels with low neutral fill, a 50mm fashion lens, vertical social portrait framing, readable sweater and pleat texture, natural skin detail under colored light, restrained highlight clipping, and subtle grain. Keep the styling preppy and fashion-editorial, clearly adult, and non-sexual.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, school uniform, underage styling, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, muddy red clipping
